# U.S. Department of Education
> The federal agency for education policy, programs, data, civil rights, and student aid in the United States.

Ed.gov is the primary federal source for K–12, higher education, adult learning, grant, research, and policy information. It also connects users to major affiliated services including Federal Student Aid, College Scorecard, Career and Technical Education, and rehabilitation and apprenticeship resources.

## Main Hubs
- [Home](https://www.ed.gov/): Department homepage with access to education topics, offices, programs, news, and services.
- [Higher Education Homepage](https://www.ed.gov/higher-education): Central hub for college planning, financial aid, loans, and postsecondary pathways.
- [Adult Programs Homepage](https://www.ed.gov/adult-programs): Entry point for adult education, literacy, and workforce-related federal programs.
- [Site Search](https://www.ed.gov/search): Search across Department pages, resources, and topic areas.

## Higher Education
- [Higher Education Homepage](https://www.ed.gov/higher-education): Overview of federal higher education resources, services, and student support topics.
- [Find a College or Educational Program](https://www.ed.gov/higher-education/find-college-or-educational-program): Tools and guidance for researching colleges, programs, and postsecondary options.
- [Community College](https://www.ed.gov/higher-education/find-college-or-educational-program/community-college): Information on community college pathways, affordability, and transfer-oriented options.
- [Pay for College](https://www.ed.gov/higher-education/paying-college): Guidance on grants, aid, costs, and planning to finance college.
- [Career Pathways](https://www.ed.gov/higher-education/career-pathways): Postsecondary and workforce pathways linking education, training, and employment outcomes.
- [Veterans and Military Families](https://www.ed.gov/higher-education/veterans-and-military-families): Higher education resources tailored to veterans, servicemembers, and military families.

## Student Aid & FAFSA
- [Federal Student Aid (FSA)](https://studentaid.gov/): Official federal student aid portal for grants, loans, work-study, and repayment.
- [Complete the FAFSA](https://studentaid.gov/h/apply-for-aid/fafsa): Start and submit the Free Application for Federal Student Aid online.
- [Pay for College](https://www.ed.gov/higher-education/paying-college): Department guidance on college costs, aid types, and affordability planning.
- [Manage Your Loans](https://www.ed.gov/higher-education/manage-your-loans): Overview of repayment, servicing, forgiveness, and loan management resources.
- [Loan Simulator](https://studentaid.gov/loan-simulator/): Estimate repayment options, monthly payments, and eligibility for federal loan programs.
- [Get your 1098-E Tax Form](https://www.ed.gov/higher-education/manage-your-loans/_098-e-tax-form): Information on obtaining student loan interest tax documentation.

## College Search & Program Discovery
- [Find a College or Educational Program](https://www.ed.gov/higher-education/find-college-or-educational-program): Starting point for comparing colleges and educational programs.
- [College Scorecard](https://collegescorecard.ed.gov/): Federal college search tool with cost, graduation, earnings, and debt data.
- [Community College](https://www.ed.gov/higher-education/find-college-or-educational-program/community-college): Resources focused on two-year institutions and related educational pathways.
- [Higher Education Homepage](https://www.ed.gov/higher-education): Broader postsecondary guidance connecting search, aid, and student support topics.

## Loans, Repayment & Tax Forms
- [Manage Your Loans](https://www.ed.gov/higher-education/manage-your-loans): Central guide to federal student loan repayment and borrower support.
- [Loan Simulator](https://studentaid.gov/loan-simulator/): Compare repayment scenarios and estimate outcomes under federal repayment plans.
- [Get your 1098-E Tax Form](https://www.ed.gov/higher-education/manage-your-loans/_098-e-tax-form): Access information about annual student loan interest tax forms.
- [Federal Student Aid (FSA)](https://studentaid.gov/): Borrower account services, aid history, and federal loan management tools.

## Career, Technical & Workforce Pathways
- [Career Pathways](https://www.ed.gov/higher-education/career-pathways): Federal guidance on education-to-career routes and workforce-aligned learning opportunities.
- [Career and Technical Education](https://cte.ed.gov/): Perkins and CTE program information, policy resources, and state implementation support.
- [Apprenticeships](https://www.apprenticeship.gov): National apprenticeship portal for career seekers, employers, and training partners.
- [Community College](https://www.ed.gov/higher-education/find-college-or-educational-program/community-college): Community college options supporting technical training and workforce entry.
- [Adult Programs Homepage](https://www.ed.gov/adult-programs): Adult learning and literacy programs connected to employment and skills development.

## Veterans & Military Families
- [Veterans and Military Families](https://www.ed.gov/higher-education/veterans-and-military-families): Dedicated education resources for veterans, servicemembers, and their families.
- [Information for Military Families and Veterans](https://www.ed.gov/higher-education/veterans-and-military-families/education-benefits-military-personnel-and-their-families): Overview of education benefits and support for military-connected learners.
- [8 Keys to Veteran Success](https://www.ed.gov/higher-education/veterans-and-military-families/_-keys-to-veterans-success-sites): Institutional best practices for supporting veterans in higher education.
- [Federal Student Aid (FSA)](https://studentaid.gov/): Student aid information relevant to military-connected students and borrowers.

## Adult Education & Rehabilitation
- [Adult Programs Homepage](https://www.ed.gov/adult-programs): Adult education, literacy, and related federal program information.
- [Vocational Rehabilitation](https://rsa.ed.gov): Rehabilitation Services Administration resources for vocational rehabilitation programs and services.
- [Career Pathways](https://www.ed.gov/higher-education/career-pathways): Career-connected learning pathways relevant to adult and returning learners.
- [Apprenticeships](https://www.apprenticeship.gov): Work-based training opportunities that complement adult education and reskilling.

## Related Federal Education Services
- [Federal Student Aid (FSA)](https://studentaid.gov/): Official student aid platform for applications, account access, and borrower services.
- [College Scorecard](https://collegescorecard.ed.gov/): Data-driven college comparison service published by the Department of Education.
- [Career and Technical Education](https://cte.ed.gov/): Specialized portal for CTE policy, grants, and implementation resources.
- [Vocational Rehabilitation](https://rsa.ed.gov): RSA portal for disability, rehabilitation, and employment support programs.
- [Apprenticeships](https://www.apprenticeship.gov): Federal apprenticeship information supporting workforce development and training.
